byte_protocol.canonical_json: UTF-8 ensure_ascii=false sorted_keys compact_separators; reject duplicate keys, non-finite numbers and invalid Unicode
byte_protocol.timing_contract_sha256: SHA256(exact contract file bytes); not embedded as a self-reference
byte_protocol.document_commitment: SHA256(fixed domain || NUL || canonical(document with only its own commitment field omitted))
byte_protocol.runtime_plan_core: canonical runtime plan with only external_plan_binding_sha256 and timing_plan_commitment_sha256 omitted; all other fields included
byte_protocol.record_and_usage_hashes: SHA256(canonical(completion_record)) and SHA256(canonical(completion_record.usage)); derived from the SAME verified terminal event

acyclic_order: candidate source and normative contract freeze
runtime plan core and timing plan
full runtime plan including timing-plan commitment
authorization grant binding the full runtime plan
execution binding plus fresh clock domain
record/usage hashes and completed timing segment
combined terminal event referencing segment hash
final audit heads and phase timing evidence
artifact manifest binding audit and timing files
publication receipt binding manifest and timing file bytes
semantic_rules: all required schema fields must be present; null is not zero and absence is not null
all timing offsets are JSON-safe integer relative nanoseconds in one clock domain; units do not claim clock resolution
plan max_attempts is at least planned case count and at most count times max_attempts_per_case
plan commitment and raw contract hash match independent frozen expectations
evidence planning binding exactly matches timing plan; execution binding hash is recomputed
segment indices are consecutive in plan case-prefix order; per-case indices begin at zero and respect caps
request_index equals attempt_index; response indices advance only for accepted or rejected responses
every segment matches exactly one terminal projection including record and usage hashes; projections remain non-authoritative inputs here
accepted response may use recorded or mapping-unmapped event; outer completion-state gate must still reject unmapped
accepted/rejected/http_error/outcome_unknown require a send; no_response/cancelled are no-send kinds matching the predecessor transport taxonomy
only accepted response segments contain completion_record_sha256 and usage_sha256
known offsets are nondecreasing within a segment; lifetime ends at raw cleanup terminal or not-applicable transport terminal
request duration is at most request_timeout_ns; every send begins strictly before phase_timeout_ns
known lifetime end of the previous attempt is at most the next attempt start; equality is allowed
unknown lifetime, failed raw cleanup or non-accepted terminal forbids any later attempt
phase task release precedes key load; sends follow both; phase end follows all recorded lifetimes, post cleanup and key release
phase end is at most phase_timeout_ns; missing phase/lifetime data is incomplete evidence, never a duration of zero

timing gate completeness requires live_monotonic_capture provenance, every planned case with an accepted response, all attempts accepted, raw cleanup completed, post cleanup completed and key references released
publication sealing starts at or after phase end and finishes within artifact_sealing_timeout_ns; unknown sealing is not sealed
UTC, SDK latency aggregates and token counters are forbidden substitutes for these durations
